name: Chilion
title: Elimelech and Naomi's son from Bethlehem
summary: Chilion was one of the two sons of Elimelech and Naomi from Bethlehem in Judah. He moved with his family to Moab during a famine, married the Moabite woman Orpah, and died there without leaving any children. His death contributed to the tragic circumstances that led Naomi back to Bethlehem.

keyEvents.title: The Family Leaves Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: Due to a famine in the land of Judah, Elimelech took his wife Naomi and their sons Mahlon and Chilion to the land of Moab to live there as foreigners.

keyEvents.title: Settling in Moab
keyEvents.description: The family settled in Moab and stayed there. Chilion and his brother Mahlon grew up in this foreign land.

keyEvents.title: Elimelech Dies
keyEvents.description: Elimelech's death in Moab left Naomi alone with her two sons, Mahlon and Kilion, who now had to support the family.

keyEvents.title: Marriage to Moabite women
keyEvents.description: Kilion and Mahlon took Moabite wives. Kilion married Orpah, while Mahlon married Ruth. They lived there for about ten years.

keyEvents.title: The death of Kilion and Mahlon
keyEvents.description: Both Mahlon and Kilion died in Moab without leaving children, which left Naomi without a husband and without sons in a foreign land.

keyEvents.title: The memory of Kilion in Bethlehem
keyEvents.description: When Boaz redeemed Mahlon's property and took Ruth as his wife, the names of Mahlon and Kilion were mentioned in connection with the restoration of the deceased's inheritance in Israel.
